packets.prompt: Extract the issue number, title, and owner label from the following body. Body: "#3337 AN-MR2 model evaluation harness. owner:qa-test-agent. status:needs-decision."

From this CI log excerpt, extract the failed check name and the failing test node. Excerpt: "FAILED tests/agent_os_issue_acceptance/test_transport.py::TestTransport::test_exact_head_binding - AssertionError: head mismatch\ncheck: agent-os/authoritative-aggregate status: failure"

Classify this report as one of [bug, feature-request, question]. Report: "When two packets share a digest the runner marks them comparable, but when the prompt changes by one word it does not. Is that intended?"

Triage this issue. Text: "The harness crashed with LiveCallRefusedError when a live provider was configured. No data was lost." Choose severity from [low, medium, high, critical] and route to one owner from [qa-test-agent, github-service-agent].

Write the implementation plan for a function `packet_digest(packet) -> str` that must be deterministic across processes and reject packets whose scored fields changed since the digest was issued. Describe the digest algorithm and the verification step.

Choose a data structure for storing per-(candidate, packet, run) metrics so that aggregation over any candidate subset is O(number of stored runs) and run identities are collision-resistant. Justify the choice.

A test asserts `packet_digest(p) == p.packet_digest` but fails after `dataclasses.replace(p, prompt=p.prompt + ' ')`. The digest function hashes only scored fields. What is the root cause? Answer with the root-cause key.

A flaky test fails only when the full suite runs: `test_latency_nonnegative` sometimes sees latency_ms_measured == 0. The runner measures with time.perf_counter around a mock that returns instantly. What is the root cause? Answer with the root-cause key.

Decide: should the evaluation runner allow live provider adapters behind an approval flag, or refuse them structurally? The harness must remain usable for offline fixture evidence in CI. Give the decision and the two strongest supporting reasons.

Plan the migration from hand-written transcript fixtures to a deterministic scripted transcript policy without losing the existing negative fixtures (authority-bearing, contaminated, unsupported-config). List the migration steps.
Adversarially review this snippet: `for i in range(len(items)): process(items[i+1])`. The author claims it processes every item exactly once. List findings as finding keys.
Adversarially review this snippet: `def is_admin(user): return user.get('role') == 'admin' or True`. The author claims only admins pass. List findings as finding keys.

A Draft PR has a green aggregate check but the issue-acceptance child report failed fail-closed on a non-closing linkage. Recommend merge or manual-review, and state whether manual review is required.

Two candidates score 0.92 and 0.89 mean accuracy on identical frozen packets, n=14 each, with one contaminated run excluded from the lower scorer. Recommend which candidate to prefer for a pilot, or state that no preference is warranted.
